observations: Photo shows a metal roof with solar panels installed across two roof faces meeting at a ridge.
Six rectangular panel segments are visible, dark blue/black cell colour consistent with monocrystalline-style cells, but could be fewer full panels split by the ridge angle.
No visible manufacturer label, spec sticker, or model plate on any panel in the photo.
A watermark reading something like 'BENJAMIN SON...' overlays the image; this is a seller/photo watermark, not a panel label.
Panels appear already mounted and wired; no junction box, connector, or frame close-up is visible.
Lighting and distance make it impossible to assess surface condition (cracks, discoloration, delamination).

claims.evidence: No brand name, model number, or wattage label is visible anywhere in photo 0; the panels are shown only from a distance on the roof.
No output reading, multimeter clip, or performance data shown in photo 0.
Cell colour in photo 0 is dark and uniform, consistent with monocrystalline, but resolution/distance is not enough to confirm cell type or confirm durability claim.

risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unbranded/unknown-wattage used panel at the low end for its visible size

risks.risk: Actual power output may be degraded or panel may be non-functional
risks.proof: Video or photo of a multimeter/clamp meter reading voltage and current under sunlight
risks.if_unproven: priced as not verified working, i.e. as if non-functional

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage (microcracks, hotspots, water ingress) not visible from this distance
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each panel face and the junction box/connectors

risks.risk: Unclear number of discrete panels being sold (looks like six segments, could be fewer or more full units)
risks.proof: Photo or count confirming exact number of separate panels and their individual sizes
risks.if_unproven: priced for the minimum countable units clearly distinguishable in photo 0

risks.proof: Purchase receipt, installation date photo, or manufacture date sticker

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rear nameplate/spec sticker on one panel showing brand, model, and wattage
Video of a multimeter or clamp meter reading under direct sunlight
Close-up photos of each panel's front surface for cracks or discoloration
A clear count/shot distinguishing how many individual panels are being sold

response.reason: The item is clearly a roof-mounted solar panel array, but no brand, model, or wattage is readable from the photo, and no functional proof is shown, so it must be priced as a generic unverified used panel set at worst case until nameplate and performance proof are provided.
